title: Trailforge Studios - Equipment
description: A Vanilla+ texture pack that refreshes tools, weapons, armor, and other equipment while staying true to Minecraft’s style.
body:
# Trailforge Studios – Equipment

Give your gear a fresh new look without losing Minecraft’s familiar style.

**Trailforge Studios - Equipment** is a Vanilla+ texture pack that redesigns tools, weapons, armor, and other equipment while staying true to the original game. The textures feel more detailed and polished, but still blend naturally into the Minecraft world.

Whether you are starting a new survival world, building a modpack, or simply want your equipment to feel a little more refined, this pack offers a clean visual upgrade without changing Minecraft’s identity.

### Features
- Redesigned tools, weapons, armor, and equipment
- Vanilla+ art style
- Clean and consistent textures
- Fits naturally into survival and adventure gameplay
- Works well alongside other Vanilla-style resource packs

A simple equipment refresh for players who love the classic Minecraft look but want a little more detail.
